snippet.title: Solo Dev Flies Over a 300m Boss in Unreal Engine 5 | Colossus Rising Test
snippet.description:
Early test footage from COGHEIM, a steampunk MMO and 4X strategy game I'm building solo in Unreal Engine 5.

This is the Colossus, the thing that comes for your city. In the finished game it targets the weakest Strider on the server, so the whole point of it is that it should feel like too much to handle. Today was the first time I flew the Slipstreamer past it to see whether the scale actually lands in engine instead of just on paper.

It does.

What you're seeing is test footage, not a trailer. Gray boxes, placeholder parts, no final paint, no final lighting, no sound pass. This is what the work really looks like at this stage, and I'd rather show it that way than wait two years for something polished.

ABOUT COGHEIM
Your city is alive, your city moves, and your city is your only home. Players form Syndicates and crew Striders, walkable fortress cities that carry hundreds of people across a post apocalyptic world. The world comes out of a five book novel series I wrote before any of this existed, so the history, the factions and the language carved into the ruins were all there first.

Built by one person in Unreal Engine 5. New test footage and devlogs as the work happens.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/DqVfe26DY
